reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses general concepts of high-entropy materials and supported nanoparticles, but provides no specific data on AlNbTiZr MEA coatings, the formation of Nb2Zr6O17/ZrO2 scales, their oxidation resistance in steam, or their effect on Zr-alloy cladding service properties. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: AlNbTiZr MEA with ~10 at.% Al forms a dense, self-healing oxide scale of Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2
This oxide scale significantly reduces high-temperature steam oxidation on Zr-alloy cladding
The coating does not compromise service properties of the cladding
The mechanism relies on controlled Al content promoting a continuous, adherent, oxygen-diffusion barrier
